description.value:
Crimson-Nail Phoenix Flower. A refined version of Hosenka in which the user has slipped a thin shuriken inside each fireball. You make up to three spell attack rolls against creatures within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage (the shuriken lodges in the wound and continues to burn).

Heightened (+2) Damage per hit increases by 2d6 and persistent bleed by 1d4.

system.requirements: you have at least 3 shuriken in your possession
